segments.name: Real estate technology
segments.description: An early-stage holding company building a global real estate technology ecosystem combining a social portal with a digital-first brokerage model for agents, brokers and consumers.
segments.evidence: The Company is building a global real estate technology ecosystem that combines a proprietary social portal with a digital-first real estate brokerage model.

revenueModel.text: The company has generated only limited advisory and consultancy service revenue to date, and expects future revenue from brokerage commissions, technology licensing fees, and value-added services.
revenueModel.evidence: Our monetization model will be driven by a combination of: (i) gross commission income from brokerage transactions, (ii) licensing fees for technology and productivity tools, and (iii) value-added services, such as premium marketing, lead generation, and data analytics.

changes.text: In 2024, the Company consummated the Business Combination with Nova SPAC, becoming the holding company of RMHL and its subsidiaries.
changes.evidence: On November 19, 2024, the parties consummated the Business Combination, and an aggregate of 200,133 Nova Shares were redeemed.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company transitioned from a pure-play social app to a vertically integrated, technology-enabled real estate platform built through acquisitions and partnerships.
changes.evidence: In Q3 2025, the Company underwent a comprehensive strategic transformation in response to significant shifts in capital markets, macroeconomic conditions, and structural disruptions within the real estate brokerage ecosystem.
